reviews.title: Pacing needs adjustment
reviews.text: I have played many virtual villagers installments over the years. One thing I like about this one is the ability to use youth divine power so my most valued villagers do not pass away. With that said, I realize there is an effort to monetize the game, but for some of the puzzles, the pacing is glacial. Like why do we need to wait a full day for 2 jellyfish to appear? Why do we spend countless hours to get the blueberries growing, only to make the blueberry grunt ONE time, then  blue paint and that’s it? Why aren’t there more ongoing uses for all the ingredients? Tbh there is hardly any point to collecting much of anything besides vines and bamboo more than the about 20x you may require them for a puzzle. Why are the lava stone rewards for solving puzzles so paltry? I could go on, but the basic is I think they failed tremendously on the pacing, and there is really no micro to speak of (like teaching kids). Also no likes or dislikes beyond your starting villagers.

Sheesh I’m stuck on pretty much all my puzzles bcz i need 6 digits to get level 2 spirituality ..like I have to chose between having farmers or just have the whole village doing research so i can get the points so I can move forward .i have an entire group researching rn and its still accumulating slowly. Just something to consider ..perhaps lowering the in game cost to purchase or just making it more attainable to get tech points ..I can spend $10 on a lemur and it is a 100% chance that they find stuff but it doesn’t mean they’ll find tech points all the time 🤷🏾‍♀️

I have all techs maxed, master builder, insecticide made, but it tells me we need plans for the school. My chalk board is blacked out, so no new plans. Anger. Trying to drop villagers into specific spots just to research or gather or work and it almost always flips to flirting or chatting. Puzzles make no sense. Crafting? Despicable. To make a torch, you don’t just dunk a bamboo stick in oil. Some fabric or tinder is always used. I have invested weeks in this game, but was so VERY close to deleting. But it is a work night. But once I find a replacement for this idle time kind of game, this one is going to the rubbish heap, WHERE IT BELONGS!
